Comment: ZEITZEUGE — one photograph, intake to archivist sign-off. Skeleton: states and wiring are real, task ARNs are templated, agent payloads are TODO.

Intake.Comment: Validate asset, build derivatives, extract EXIF, pair recto/verso.

Perception.Comment: Tier 1 — independent observers. None of them may see another's output.

PartialPerception.Comment: One flaky observer must not kill an investigation. Record the gap as evidence and continue with lower confidence.

Grounding.Comment: Tier 2 — resolve observations against the Schwyz gazetteer, swisstopo, GWR, Wikidata.

Hypothesise.Comment: Tier 3 — generate competing location/date hypotheses with priors. Never one answer.

Falsify.Comment: Each hypothesis must survive an attempt to kill it. Terrain falsification runs here.

TerrainFalsification.Comment: DEM raycast: does the horizon this hypothesis predicts match the photographed skyline?

FalsifierUnavailable.Comment: Fallback: precomputed ridgelines from S3. The demo does not depend on a warm endpoint.

ChronologyCheck.Comment: Dating by what could not yet exist: refute any date that predates an object in frame.

RedTeam.Comment: An independent model argues against the surviving hypotheses. Independence is the point — different provider where possible.

Adjudicate.Comment: Weigh evidence, set per-field confidence, and abstain where the evidence does not reach threshold. Calibrated silence is a feature.

SensitivityGuard.Comment: Face DETECTION only, never identification. publication_hold defaults on for identifiable people in photographs under 100 years old.

Produce.Comment: Emit the catalogue record with a provenance block per field: ISAD(G), EAD, DC, IIIF, RiC-O, XMP.

AwaitArchivist.Comment: Human sign-off as a durable state. A run may wait days for a reviewer to return — the token, not a poll loop, holds the place.

ReviewExpired.Comment: Seven days without review: park the record in the queue, do not publish.

Learn.Comment: Write the correction back to collection memory. human_override_rate should fall over time — that is the product's true north.
